question: How can you open an existing document in Microsoft Word 2016?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Press Ctrl + O**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Press Ctrl + O** is the shortcut to open an existing document in Microsoft Word 2016.
 
• Using this shortcut will bring up the Open dialog box, allowing you to browse and select the document you want to open.
 
• This shortcut is a quick and efficient way to access previously created documents without having to navigate through multiple
